title: Searching for Robust Augmentations to Improve Out-of-Domain Generalization in Dermoscopic Skin Cancer Classification
abstract: arXiv:2607.26765v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Background/Objectives: Dermoscopic skin-lesion classifiers lose accuracy when images arrive from a new clinic or a new device. We asked which data augmentations reduce that loss, and measured the effect under a protocol that keeps policy selection separate from policy evaluation. Methods: A ConvNeXt-Large binary malignant-versus-non-malignant classifier was trained on six dermoscopic sources (25,903 images); HAM10000 and ISIC 2016-2020 were held out of training entirely. Single augmentations, photometric combinations and eleven composite policies were ranked on a development split of 1511 held-out images. The winning policy was then evaluated on a confirmation set of 8073 held-out images that took no part in that ranking and from which we removed every image sharing a lesion identifier with the training data and every image contributed by an institution represented in training. Both policies were retrained with four random seed

translated_title: 寻找鲁棒的数据增强方法以提升皮肤镜皮肤癌分类的域外泛化能力
translated_abstract: 背景与目标：当图像来自新的诊所或新设备时，皮肤镜皮肤病变分类器的准确率会下降。我们探究哪些数据增强方法可以减少这种性能损失，并在一种将策略选择与策略评估相分离的协议下测量其效果。方法：在六个皮肤镜数据来源（共25,903张图像）上训练了ConvNeXt-Large二分类器（恶性与非恶性）；HAM10000和ISIC 2016-2020完全排除在训练之外。在由1511张保留图像构成的开发集上，对单一增强、光度组合以及十一种复合策略进行排序。随后，获胜策略在由8073张保留图像组成的确认集上进行评估，这些图像未参与排序，并且我们移除了其中所有与训练数据共享病变标识符的图像以及所有来自训练集中已出现机构的图像。两种策略均使用四个随机种子重新训练。
tldr: 该研究通过将增强策略的选择与评估严格分离的协议系统搜索数据增强方法，发现最优复合增强策略能显著提升皮肤镜皮肤癌分类器对来自新诊所和新设备的域外图像的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: By systematically searching for data augmentations under a protocol that separates policy selection from evaluation, this study identifies a winning composite augmentation policy that substantially improves the out-of-domain generalization of dermoscopic skin cancer classifiers to images from new clinics and devices.
